title: STUN: Handle UDP messages with multiple PDUs, WhatsApp methods
description:
Handle UDP STUN messages with multiple PDUs.

RFC 7983 (updated by 9443) restricts STUN to packets with the
first byte in the [0,3] range, corresponding with STUN methods
0x00-0xFF, to allow for multiplexing with other protocols over
UDP commonly used with STUN, e.g., RTP/RTCP and DTLS. However,
the RFC recommends dropping packets with the first byte in the
[4,15] range, corresponding with STUN methods 0x100-0x3FF, and

Since no known protocol multiplexed with STUN uses values that
would conflict in that somewhat larger range, allow them if
the 4-byte magic cookie is present, which should be sufficient
to prevent false positives.

Fix #20560

Checked against the files from #18148 and !814
